# Irving & Lavendar Lewis

- [Irving](../character/irving.md) — Spouse of — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Change P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to spend an evening with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. Over tea and candy, Miss Lavendar confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026)_

> Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a lovely ceremony attended by their friends. After seeing the newlyweds off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finish tidying the house, where a brief romantic spark between them hints at the changing chapter of Anne's life.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends her summer vacation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), feeling a quiet loneliness over her strained friendship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys visits with [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss Lavendar, though [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) realizes he is growing too old for his childhood imaginary friends, and Miss Lavendar cautions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) were meant for each other.
>
